title: Evaluation of the dual formula
statement: For a DNF formula $\varphi$ on $n$ variables and an assignment $x\in\{0,1\}^n$, the De Morgan dual CNF evaluates to the Boolean negation of the value of $\varphi$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ variables
$x$ is an assignment to those variables
replaced:
Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ variables — a disjunction of terms, each term a
conjunction of literals — and let $x \in \{0,1\}^n$ be an assignment. Form its De~Morgan
dual CNF by negating every literal of every term of $\varphi$ and reading each resulting
term as a clause (a disjunction of literals), so that the whole is a conjunction of
clauses. Then this dual CNF evaluates on $x$ to the negation of the value of $\varphi$
on $x$.
